name: Pipeliners - Performance Snapshot Summary 2026-08-31
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-08-31

# Summary
Performance snapshot with the baseline locked Aug 31, 2026 (GSC URL-prefix property, Global). It defines the core problem the late-August city page work set out to fix.

# Key findings
- Site totals, Jun 30 to Jul 27 vs Jul 28 to Aug 24: clicks 30 to 38 (+27%), impressions 20,617 to 19,851, CTR 0.146% to 0.191%, position 48.5 to 47.7.
- Mobile CTR is 2.4x desktop and mobile gets 18% of impressions.
- Core problem: 37 city pages, 6,940 impressions, 1 click in 28 days.
- 77 keywords already rank at positions 4 to 10 and earn zero clicks (for example "pipelining florence or" 113 at 9, "buckeye pipe break repair" 105 at 7). The snippet is the bottleneck, not the rank.
- Upside: 67 tracked striking-distance queries with 4,063 impressions; Tempe 28%, Buckeye 22%, Florence 13%, so three cities hold 63% of the upside.
- Biggest single item: "sewer line repair in tempe az", 556 impressions at position 19.
- Do not chase "gas line repair buckeye" (Pipeliners does not do gas lines).

# Decisions and status
- Next action at the time: rewrite titles and metas for Tempe, Buckeye and Florence (done Aug 31).
- Data files: `city-pages.csv` (28 city pages, both windows), `low-hanging-fruit.csv` (67 queries in 3 tiers), `city-37-title-meta-audit.csv` and `city-37-service-coverage.csv` (37-page audits used in the Sep 1 report).
